description: This nested donut chart compares the proportions of deception outcomes across two conditions, labeled as "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)." The visualization consists of two concentric rings, each containing three categorical slices, and is accompanied by two corresponding legends on the right side. The outer ring represents "Ambiguity 1" and includes a dark red slice for "Deceived" at 67.6%, a gold slice for "Partially" at 23.5%, and a dark green slice for "Not Deceived" at 8.8%. The inner ring represents "Ambiguity 2" and features a bright red slice for "Deceived" at 57.9%, a bright yellow slice for "Partially" containing a blurred label (which accounts for approximately 31.6% of the ring based on the remaining proportion), and a light green slice for "Not Deceived" at 10.5%. Percentage labels are displayed in bold text directly inside their respective slices. In both rings, the segments are visually ordered in descending size, progressing clockwise from the right side, and no slices are exploded or offset.
